notes: SEQN is the unique participant identifier in NHANES, mapping to person_source_value in the person table.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight, stored as a numeric observation. A custom concept for the weight type would be needed in observation_concept_id.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight, stored as a numeric observation. A custom concept for the weight type would be needed in observation_concept_id.
Food/Individual component number is an ordinal identifier for food items within a dietary recall, stored as a numeric observation.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating the status of the recall. A standard concept for recall status should be used if available; otherwise a custom concept.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer, stored as a string observation. Could also be linked to provider table if interviewers are considered providers.
Breast-fed infant indicator is a binary variable. A standard concept for breastfeeding status should be used (e.g., 4075927 'Breastfeeding status').
Number of days of intake is a categorical variable indicating how many days of dietary data are available. A custom concept would be needed.
Number of days between intake and household interview is a continuous numeric variable, stored as a numeric observation.
Intake day of the week is a categorical variable. A standard concept for day of week (e.g., from vocabulary) should be used if available.
Language respondent used mostly is a categorical variable. A standard concept for language (e.g., 4182343 'Language') should be used.
Combination food number is an ordinal identifier for combination foods, stored as a numeric observation.
Combination food type is a categorical/text variable describing the type of combination food, stored as a string observation.
Time of eating occasion (HH:MM) is a time variable. Could be stored as string or converted to a time concept. observation_time field could also be used if appropriate.
Name of eating occasion (e.g., breakfast, lunch) is a categorical variable. A standard concept for meal type should be used if available (e.g., 4075928 'Meal type').

Source of food is a categorical variable describing where food was obtained. It maps to observation value_as_concept_id using a custom concept or source concept, as no single standard OMOP concept covers all NHANES source categories.
Binary indicator for whether meal was eaten at home. Could map to Yes/No concepts (e.g., 4188539/4188540) but context-specific; stored as observation with appropriate concept.
USDA food code is an identifier linking to food composition data. Not a standard concept; stored as string in observation or mapped to a food concept table if available.
Modification code indicates type of modification to food (e.g., fortified, reduced fat). Categorical; requires custom concepts.
Grams of food consumed. Could map to a mass measurement concept (e.g., 8582 for 'gram'), but specific food amount is typically stored as measurement value with unit concept.
Energy in kcal. Concept 4325373 represents 'Energy' (kilocalories). Measurement value_as_number holds the numeric value.
Protein in grams. Concept 3016212 is 'Protein intake'. Value_as_number stores the amount.
Carbohydrate in grams. Concept 3016723 is 'Carbohydrate intake'. Value_as_number stores the amount.
Total sugars in grams. Concept 3006103 is 'Sugars intake'. Value_as_number stores the amount.
Dietary fiber in grams. Concept 3017750 is 'Fiber intake'. Value_as_number stores the amount.
Total fat in grams. Concept 3018620 is 'Total fat intake'. Value_as_number stores the amount.
Saturated fatty acids in grams. Concept 3018621 is 'Saturated fat intake'. Value_as_number stores the amount.
Monounsaturated fatty acids in grams. Concept 3018622 is 'Monounsaturated fat intake'. Value_as_number stores the amount.
Polyunsaturated fatty acids in grams. Concept 3018623 is 'Polyunsaturated fat intake'. Value_as_number stores the amount.
Cholesterol in mg. Concept 3017123 is 'Cholesterol intake'. Value_as_number stores the amount.
Vitamin E as alpha-tocopherol intake in mg. Maps to Measurement with concept for alpha-tocopherol.
Added alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E) in mg. No standard concept for 'added' form; could use same concept as alpha-tocopherol or a nutrient supplement concept.
Retinol intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for retinol.
Vitamin A, RAE in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for vitamin A.
Alpha-carotene intake in mcg. No standard concept; could use a generic carotenoid concept or leave null.
Beta-carotene intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for beta-carotene.
Beta-cryptoxanthin intake in mcg. No standard concept; could use a generic carotenoid concept.
Lycopene intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for lycopene.
Lutein + zeaxanthin intake in mcg. No standard concept for combined measure; could use separate concepts or leave null.
Thiamin (Vitamin B1) intake in mg. Maps to Measurement with concept for thiamin.
Riboflavin (Vitamin B2) intake in mg. Maps to Measurement with concept for riboflavin.
Niacin intake in mg. Maps to Measurement with concept for niacin.
Vitamin B6 intake in mg. Maps to Measurement with concept for vitamin B6.
Total folate intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for folate.
Folic acid intake in mcg. No standard concept for folic acid specifically; could use folate concept or a supplement concept.
Food folate intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of folate intake. Concept 3007220 represents Folate [Mass].
Dietary Folate Equivalents (DFE) intake in mcg. Concept 3018620 represents Folate, DFE [Mass].
Total choline intake in mg. Concept 3009497 represents Choline [Mass].
Vitamin B12 intake in mcg. Concept 3005105 represents Vitamin B12 [Mass].
Added vitamin B12 intake in mcg. No standard OMOP concept for 'added' vitamin B12; could use 3005105 (Vitamin B12) with a modifier or custom concept.
Vitamin C intake in mg. Concept 3005131 represents Vitamin C [Mass].
Vitamin D (D2 + D3) intake in mcg. Concept 3014502 represents Vitamin D [Mass].
Vitamin K intake in mcg. Concept 3004739 represents Vitamin K [Mass].
Calcium intake in mg. Concept 3003629 represents Calcium [Mass].
Phosphorus intake in mg. Concept 3006497 represents Phosphorus [Mass].
Magnesium intake in mg. Concept 3006881 represents Magnesium [Mass].
Iron intake in mg. Concept 3004470 represents Iron [Mass].
Zinc intake in mg. Concept 3009131 represents Zinc [Mass].
Copper intake in mg. Concept 3001122 represents Copper [Mass].
Sodium intake in mg. Concept 3019550 represents Sodium [Mass].
Potassium intake in mg; maps to OMOP measurement of potassium. Use concept_id for 'Potassium [Mass]'.
Selenium intake in mcg; maps to 'Selenium [Mass]' measurement.
Caffeine intake in mg; maps to 'Caffeine [Mass]' measurement.
Theobromine intake in mg; no standard OMOP concept for theobromine mass. Could use a custom concept or map to nutrient intake.
Alcohol intake in gm; maps to 'Alcohol intake' measurement concept.
Moisture (water) intake in gm; no direct standard concept. Could map to 'Water intake' if available, else custom.
Saturated fatty acid 4:0 intake; specific fatty acid subtypes lack standard OMOP concepts. Use custom concept or map to 'Fatty acid intake'.
SFA 6:0 intake; no standard concept for individual fatty acid mass.
SFA 8:0 intake; no standard concept.
SFA 10:0 intake; no standard concept.
SFA 12:0 intake; no standard concept.
SFA 14:0 intake; no standard concept.
SFA 16:0 intake; no standard concept.
SFA 18:0 intake; no standard concept.
Monounsaturated fatty acid 16:1 intake; no standard concept for individual MFA mass.

MFA 18:1 (Octadecenoic) intake in grams. Map to measurement table with value_as_number. Requires a measurement_concept_id for the specific fatty acid (e.g., 18:1 monounsaturated fatty acid intake), which is not provided here.

PFA 20:5 (Eicosapentaenoic) intake in grams. Map to measurement table with value_as_number. Requires a measurement_concept_id for the specific polyunsaturated fatty acid.
PFA 22:5 (Docosapentaenoic) intake in grams. Map to measurement table with value_as_number. Requires a measurement_concept_id for the specific polyunsaturated fatty acid.
